facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice went to the Queen's garden. The rules did not make sense. Alice asked why. She questioned rules.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice arrived at the Queen of Hearts' beautiful rose garden. Card soldiers were painting white roses red in a big hurry. The Queen would be angry if she saw any white roses at all. She questioned rules that seemed unfair and did not make sense. Alice could not understand why everyone was so afraid. She bravely asked the soldiers why they followed such silly rules.
